note: AD-138 livestock yard (owner 2026-09-22): pens of 5x5 inside a 7x7 fence, 1/2/4 of them at yard levels I/II/III (core effect pens), each with its own feeder and trough; the keeper breeds and culls a pen above pen_cap. pens: the north-west corner {x,z} of each pen's fence in yard cells, its gate side (east/west) and the yard level that builds it; the feeder, trough and gate stand at fixed cells from that corner. feed: what each kind eats (wheat, never seeds: a chicken yard on seeds would be free meat, spec F13). culls_per_day: a pen's cap on culling per village day. feed_stock: the feed of each kind its pens keep that the yard chest holds (porters bring it; nobody takes it away).
